title: Ontario bare-earth terrain context for Future Mississauga
attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Ontario.
sourceVintages: The default service mosaic combines acquisition projects. A test point returned 2015 primary data and 2023 overview records; the rendering is not a September 2026 terrain survey.
transformCaveat: The City building vertical datum is not independently certified against this service. Building geometry is unchanged. A spatial sample of City building bases minus DTM gave a median +0.20 m, p10 -0.46 m and p90 +0.41 m; no alignment shift was applied.
nodata: Service NoData/outside valid -20..300 local metre range uses documented building-base interpolation.
presentation: Terrain polygons are subdivided for display. Parks, woodland and shore boundaries remain from City planimetric data. The current Jim Tovey reclamation outline remains unverified.
